## Reconciliation controls (after each load)

CRITICAL and ERROR controls are mandatory quality gates: a failure fails the mapping and stops the pipeline. WARNING controls are recorded and reported.

| Control | Mapping | Handler | Severity | Mandatory | Tolerance | Parameters / justification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| STG_SITE.HASH_LINEAGE | STG_SITE | RECON_HASH_LINEAGE | CRITICAL | Yes |  |  |
| STG_SITE.FRESHNESS | STG_SITE | RECON_FRESHNESS | WARNING | No |  |  |
